name: Neriv, Crackling Vanguard
oracle_text:
Flying, deathtouch
When Neriv enters, create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
Whenever Neriv attacks, exile a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the number of differently named tokens you control. During any turn you attacked with a commander, you may play those cards.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Neriv attacks, exile a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the number of differently named tokens you control.
During any turn you attacked with a commander, you may play those cards.

needs.what: a value counting the distinct names among a selector's matches -- {"distinct": {"of": "name", "objects": {"controller": "you", "is_token": true}}} -- "the number of differently named tokens you control"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `distinct` value accepts only of in DISTINCT_OF (power, basic_land_type, card_type, color, counter_kind); `count` counts tokens, not names, and `most_sharing_a_name` measures the largest group sharing one name, not how many names there are

needs.what: a playable permission on exiled cards that is open indefinitely but usable only during a turn in which the effect's controller attacked with a commander -- e.g. `playable: "while_exiled"` plus a `playable_condition` reading a per-turn 'you attacked with a commander this turn' fact (a new value/condition such as {"commanders_attacked_this_turn": "you"} > 0)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: playable_durations (this_turn, while_exiled, end_of_your_next_turn, later_turns, ...) carry no condition on the turn the card is played; `attacked_this_turn`/`attackers_this_turn` values do not filter attackers by is_commander, and no exile/look_at_top option gates the permission on a per-turn condition
